title: AnalyzeRequest
description: Request sent from the core to an analyzer.

protocol.description: Protocol version. Always 1 for this schema.

repoRoot.description: Root path of the repository being analyzed.

mode.description: Whether to run file-scope rules only or include project-scope rules.

files.description: Absolute paths of files to analyze.

rules.description: Per-rule configuration keyed by rule id. Only enabled rules appear.

options.description: Analyzer-specific options passed through opaquely from configuration.
